s006.sec8.u0: That's it, now I'm really mad!

s006.sec51.u0: Hmm? Well now, {color 6}{player}{color 1}. Looks like the
I hear you young folk are building a city.
So I've a favor to ask. Just as I helped you,
I'd like you to help me in turn.
s006.sec51.u2: Building a city means saving this island. Everyone is saved, and so am I. You see?
s006.sec51.u3: You mean you'll come to the city?
s006.sec51.u4: Mm-hm. Then I shall head to this city of yours.
s006.sec51.u6: Hmm? Say, are you a human?
Meeting me is a rare catch indeed! I'm
Coelamon, the fish Digimon. Did you come all
this way just to see me?
s006.sec51.u7: Ho ho, I see, I see!
s006.sec51.u8: Heh heh... I can tell. No need to be shy about it.
s006.sec51.u9: I've a fair idea what you're after. The bridge
upstream is broken, but you want to cross...
s006.sec51.u10: Hm, very well. I'll see what I can do.
s006.sec51.u11: Ha ha, back again, are you?
s006.sec51.u12: Go on, walk across our heads. No need to be polite. Go on, go on.
s006.sec51.u14: In this world, helping one another is what counts. Till we meet again!
